not.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pragma_table_info('expenses') WHERE name = 'user_key') THEN '1' ELSE '0' END

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE expenses_new (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, amount TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, merchant TEXT NOT NULL, date TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, receipt_photo_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT, user_key TEXT);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk ON expenses_new (user_id, user_key);

INSERT INTO expenses_new (id, amount, currency, merchant, date, category, user_id, receipt_photo_id, created_at, deleted_at) SELECT id, amount, currency, merchant, date, category, user_id, receipt_photo_id, created_at, deleted_at FROM expenses;
ALTER TABLE expenses_new RENAME TO expenses;
